temporal_caption: At 0:00 a static, high-angle security-camera view looks down on the whole intersection from a building corner: zebra crosswalks on all four sides, the white SUV coming up the road from the top left, the blue sedan waiting at the top right, the dark grey hatchback waiting at the bottom left edge, the two pedestrians on the crosswalk on the left, and the person in the green hoodie standing on the corner further left. From 0:01 to 0:03 the white SUV and the red sedan cross the middle of the intersection and pass each other; the red sedan continues toward the top left. At 0:03 and 0:04 the traffic lights change. From 0:04 to 0:07 the dark grey hatchback pulls forward from the bottom left and the blue sedan from the top right; the pedestrians reach the sidewalks.

background_setting: A four-way city intersection on a clear afternoon: grey asphalt roads with white zebra crosswalks, white stop lines and double yellow centre lines; concrete sidewalks with old-style black street lamps, a red fire hydrant, a trash can and a utility box; four- to eight-storey brick, stone and plaster buildings with shop windows on every corner and taller buildings further away.

aesthetics.color_scheme: Natural city colours: grey asphalt, white road markings, beige and red-brick buildings; a red car, a white car, a dark grey car and a blue car

cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down, from a security camera on a building corner about 15 m up

style_medium: CCTV security camera footage, photoreal live-action
context: Real-world footage of normal traffic at a signalised intersection. Realistic real-world video, natural lighting and motion, not a rendering.

actions.description: The north-south lights are green. The red sedan drives south and the white SUV drives north through the intersection, passing each other in the middle at about 0:02. The dark grey hatchback and the blue sedan wait at red lights on the east and west sides.
The pedestrian in the red jacket walks south and the pedestrian in the white shirt walks north across the zebra crosswalk on the east side, just in front of the waiting dark grey hatchback.
The north-south lights turn amber, then red.
The east-west lights turn green. The dark grey hatchback and the blue sedan pull away slowly into the intersection.
The pedestrian in the green hoodie stands on the south-east corner filming with a phone.

segments.description: One continuous fixed security-camera shot of the intersection
segments.key_changes: The north-south cars cross; the lights change; the east-west cars start
